speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: How may I help you?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I've reconsidered your offer to let me work with you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: For me.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Yes, for you. I do, however, have a few conditions. First, at all times, I am to be treated as a colleague and an equal. Second, my contributions shall be noted in all published material. And third, you are never allowed to lecture me on Hinduism or my Indian culture.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm impressed, Raj. Those are very cogent and reasonable conditions. I reject them all.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Thank you.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Then you leave me no choice. I accept the job.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm sorry, I believe you've misunderstood. I'm not giving you the job. I'm simply affording you the opportunity to apply for it. Have a seat, we'll get started with the interview.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Wha... You're kidding!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Please. So, that's what you wear to an interview?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: All right.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Come on, dude, we've been friends for years.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, pulling strings, are we?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Sheldon, for God's sakes, don't make me beg.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Bazinga! You've fallen victim to another one of my classic practical jokes. I'm your boss now. You may want to laugh at that.

speaker: penny
text: Ah, it's nice having the place to ourselves, isn't it?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Uh-huh. Now that Raj is working for Sheldon, I don't have to chauffeur him around anymore. Plus, yeah, with them working late so much, we get some privacy.

speaker: penny
text: Mm-hmm. Hey, want to get a little crazy?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What are you thinking?

speaker: penny
text: Let's slide over to Sheldon's spot a make out.
